is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii across 13 African countries (page 1533, abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Identifies SNPs in Vgsc including L995F, L995S, and N1570Y (page 1538), as well as CNVs in Cyp6aa1-Cyp6p2 (page 1542).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Target-site resistance is only presented as a pooled composite phenotype combining Vgsc-L995F and L995S ('purple, these individuals were either homozygous or heterozygous for one of the two kdr pyrethroid target site resistance alleles Vgsc-L995F/S', Figure 6, page 1540). No individual genotype counts (RR/RS/SS), allele counts, or marker-specific frequencies are provided in the main text or figures.

african_field_population.evidence: Field-caught mosquitoes collected from 13 African countries: Angola, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Equatorial Guinea (Bioko), Gabon, The Gambia, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Kenya, Mayotte, and Uganda (page 1534, Figure 1; page 1541, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary genomic resource paper reporting whole-genome sequencing of 1142 wild-caught mosquitoes and laboratory crosses for Ag1000G phase 2 (page 1533-1534).

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific collection localities are documented, such as Tiassalé (Côte d'Ivoire), Sacriba (Bioko), Njabakunda (The Gambia), and Safim (Guinea-Bissau) (page 1541).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection years are provided for sampling sites, such as Côte d'Ivoire (2012), Bioko (2002), Mayotte (2011), The Gambia (2011), Ghana (2012), and Guinea-Bissau (2010) (page 1541).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study directly represents Phase 2 of the MalariaGEN Anopheles gambiae 1000 Genomes (Ag1000G) Project and re-analyzes all samples from Phase 1 (The Anopheles gambiae 1000 Genomes Consortium 2017) alongside newly added samples (page 1533-1534).

supplement.evidence: Granular sample metadata and individual variant calls are housed in supplemental files and external repositories: 'Further details of samples novel to phase 2 can be found in the Supplemental Material' (page 1541) and at ENA PRJEB36277 / MalariaGEN public FTP site (page 1543).

assessment.summary: This study reports the second phase of the Anopheles gambiae 1000 Genomes (Ag1000G) project, sequencing 1142 wild-caught An. gambiae and An. coluzzii mosquitoes across 13 African countries. While Vgsc target-site mutations (L995F, L995S, N1570Y) and metabolic resistance CNVs are examined, resistance data in the main paper are presented solely as pooled composite categories (grouping L995F and L995S into a single kdr class and pooling various Cyp amplifications) without extractable marker-specific genotype or allele frequencies.
exclusion_reasons: reports_extractable_genotype_data: L995F and L995S are pooled together into a single composite target-site resistance category in Figure 6 and the text, without extractable marker-specific genotype counts or allele frequencies per population.
